description: The QualiLoop user guide: with no topic_key, the list of topics (key, title, section); with one, that topic's full text and its link in the app. Use it to explain how the product works in the app's own words. The in-app assistant already has the whole guide in its instructions and uses this only to re-read one topic closely.
